source_of_truth: Operator request 2026-07-27: plan Buzz.xyz integration for DontPanic, incorporating critical new-user feedback that README claims Claude/Codex/Gemini/Grok/Ollama are executors while AGENT_REGISTRY only registers claude+codex and runtime/tests classify Gemini/Grok as operator-only. Cost topology: OpenCode → DontPanic → Claude implement / Codex audit / Gemini goal-experience → human merge. Buzz is strongly recommended (signup + private community), not a hard dependency. Community model: private default; Silex dogfood; optional public DontPanic support. Follow-up 2026-07-27: Buzz agent UI makes harness+model selection trivial — fold Track D so AGENT_REGISTRY becomes harness adapters, models are catalog data (Grok 4.5, OpenRouter, Ollama), and worker profiles provide Buzz-like operator UX without putting model versions in the registry.
completion_test: Done when (1) docs no longer claim non-registry harnesses are shipped dispatch executors and a drift guard enforces honesty; (2) capability matrix + three-layer vocabulary (harness/model/profile) is published; (3) Gemini goal/experience path is B1 and/or B2 via harness+profile not fake registry keys; (4) Buzz signup+private community is strongly recommended (doctor WARN, not hard fail); (5) notify_buzz fail-soft + confirm-gated caller recipe exist; (6) model pass-through and worker profiles let operators select harness+model (including future versions) without new AGENT_REGISTRY keys per model; evidence records harness+model+profile when applicable. Gate-bridge (F008), dogfood (F010), extra harnesses (F014), discovery (F015), and Buzz bindings (F016) may trail core F001–F013+F005–F007+F009+F011–F012.

user_journeys.name: new-user-reads-honest-executor-panel
user_journeys.description: A new user reading README and the agent capability matrix can answer which harnesses DontPanic can dispatch today (claude, codex) versus which can only operate DontPanic (gemini, grok as operator-only until harnesses land; OpenCode as surface) without contradiction from the setup checklist, and understands that model names are not harness registry keys.
acceptance_signals: README does not list Gemini/Grok/Ollama as shipped executors while absent from harness registry
agent status / agent brief classification matches the matrix
doc-drift guard fails on reintroduced false shipped-executor claims
Docs define harness vs model vs profile

user_journeys.name: cost-topology-goal-audit
user_journeys.description: An operator uses OpenCode for planning, DontPanic for plan lock and dispatch, Claude as implementer, Codex as implementation auditor, and Gemini for goal/experience audit — either via gemini_cli harness + goal_auditor profile (B2) or via operator-driven attach-evidence (B1).
acceptance_signals: Illegal goal_auditor assignment without harness capability still refuses with a clear message
B1: Gemini-produced goal/experience audit can be recorded as first-class evidence
B2: gemini_cli harness + profile allowed for goal_auditor with tests
OpenCode is documented as operator surface, not a fake worker

user_journeys.name: buzz-strongly-recommended-setup
user_journeys.description: A new operator following GETTING_STARTED is told to sign up for Buzz and create a private community for DontPanic work. Doctor/setup warns (does not fail) if Buzz is unconfigured. They never have to join Silex or a public DontPanic community for the product to work; notify config points only at their private community.
acceptance_signals: First-run docs strongly recommend Buzz signup + private community
Doctor/setup emits advisory WARN with private-community remediation when Buzz is missing
Install does not hard-fail solely because Buzz is absent
No default config writes a maintainer public community URL
Public Silex/DontPanic communities are documented as optional support only

user_journeys.name: buzz-status-and-gates
user_journeys.description: An operator with Buzz configured to their private community receives DontPanic gate/signoff/breaker notifications via the notify sink, and can follow a skill recipe to validate and confirm-gated dispatch without DontPanic owning the Buzz relay.
acceptance_signals: Unconfigured buzz sink returns False and does not raise
Configured sink is invoked from dispatch_event for inventory events
Caller recipe never auto-confirms dispatch
ECOSYSTEM states Buzz is external caller/notify only
Example config steers to private community, not public support rooms

user_journeys.name: buzz-like-harness-and-model-selection
user_journeys.description: An operator configures workers the way Buzz does: pick a harness (Codex/Claude/Gemini/OpenRouter/Ollama) and a model (including future versions like Grok 4.5 or openrouter/… slugs) via worker profiles or model pass-through, without adding a new Python registry entry per model. Roles resolve to profiles; legacy claude/codex strings still work. Dispatch evidence records harness + model + profile id.
acceptance_signals: Worker profile can set harness + model independently
New model version requires catalog/profile change only, not a new AGENT_REGISTRY key
Implementer refused when harness lacks coding capabilities
Legacy roles.implementer=claude still dispatches
Audit/evidence includes harness and model when known

required_evidence: diff or file evidence of README/docs honesty fix (F001)
file evidence of capability matrix + OpenCode ECOSYSTEM row (F003)
test_output or CLI evidence for Gemini path B1 or B2 (F004)
file evidence of Buzz ECOSYSTEM + community model (F005)
doctor/setup evidence of advisory WARN for missing Buzz (F009)
test_output for notify_buzz fail-soft + configured path (F006)
test_output for worker profiles + legacy alias (F013)
non_goals: Implementing a Nostr relay or full Buzz client inside DontPanic
Replacing Jarvis dashboard or Firebase state projection with Buzz
Auto-merge or Tier-3 approval from unallowlisted agent keys
Registering model version strings (e.g. grok-4.5) as AGENT_REGISTRY keys
Making Grok/Ollama dispatchable without a real sandboxed harness
Posting full audit transcripts or secrets to public Buzz communities
Requiring users to join maintainer-owned Silex or DontPanic public communities
Hard-failing install when Buzz is not configured
Building a full GUI clone of Buzz agent cards in v0 (CLI + config first)
